Hero.title: Your smile, our priority
Hero.subtitle: Orthodontics clinic in Algiers. Book your consultation online in a few clicks.

Footer.tagline: Modern orthodontics in the heart of Algiers.

Booking.title: Book an appointment
Booking.intro: Book in a few clicks. The clinic will call you to confirm.
Booking.noServices: No services available right now. Please try again later.
Booking.chooseDateHint: Select a day to see available time slots.
Booking.noSlots: No slots available on that day.
Booking.consent: I agree that my details may be used to manage my booking.
Booking.consentRequired: Please accept the privacy policy to continue.
Booking.summaryConfirmNote: Your request has been recorded. The clinic will call you on the phone to confirm your appointment — it is not confirmed yet.
Booking.watchTitle: Get notified if a slot becomes free
Booking.watchIntro: Optional: choose one or more days to watch. If a cancellation frees a slot on one of those days, we will send you an SMS.
Booking.watchSuggest: Days you browsed with no available slot:
Booking.watchOptOut: No thanks, I don't want to be notified.
Booking.successNote: Thank you! The clinic will call you on the phone to confirm your appointment. It is not confirmed yet.
Booking.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
Booking.errorConflict: That slot was just taken. Please choose another one.
Booking.errorRateLimited: Too many requests. Please try again a little later.
Booking.errorPendingLimit: You already have 3 pending requests awaiting confirmation. The clinic will call to confirm them — please wait or try again later.
Booking.whatsappOptIn: I agree to be contacted on WhatsApp to confirm my appointment and for reminders.

SelfService.title: Manage my appointment
SelfService.intro: Here is the detail of your appointment. You can cancel it or move it to an available slot.
SelfService.cancelConfirmText: This action is immediate and final.
SelfService.rescheduleIntro: Choose a new day, then an available slot.
SelfService.chooseDateHint: Already-booked slots are shown as reserved.
SelfService.successCancelText: Your appointment has been cancelled. We hope to see you again soon.
SelfService.successRescheduleText: Your appointment has been moved. An SMS with your new management link has been sent.
SelfService.errTokenUsed: This link has already been used.
SelfService.errAppointmentUnavailable: This appointment can no longer be changed.
SelfService.errRateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
SelfService.errGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
SelfService.errConflict: This slot was just taken. Please choose another one.
SelfService.errNoSlots: No slot available that day. Choose another day.
